description: Shared quantitative circuit breaker parameters for the PropWire terminal & cron runner, namespaced per sport and versioned. NFL values are the exact calibrated pre-refactor values (proven byte-identical by test/nfl-parity.snapshot.mjs). Each sport owns its own block; do NOT copy NFL yardage thresholds to another sport. Blocks without backtest evidence must carry "calibrated": false and "calibration": "uncalibrated_tuning_parameters" and will surface a visible research-only badge in the UI.

messaging.stale_baseline_warning: Market line moved sharply vs opening quote. Model baseline may be stale; verify active news before trading.
messaging.beneficiary_oversteam_warning: Line moved beyond model target absorption capacity. Potential second-order news or book over-reaction.
messaging.high_edge_warning: Large edge (≥15%) on liquid book. May indicate stale projection or recent news; check status before acting.
messaging.stale_feed_warning: News watcher feed is stale (>5m). Automated alert dispatch is suppressed.

nba.label: NBA
nba.note: NBA v1 ships research fixtures only (no backtest evidence). Drift bounds are order-of-magnitude placeholders scaled to NBA stat variance (points ~6x receptions). The UI must surface the research-only badge while calibrated is false.
